{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Calculate mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the mean flipper length for each species
print("Mean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
species_with_highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
mean_flipper_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

# Print the result
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {species_with_highest_mean} ({mean_flipper_value:.2f} mm)")"}
